title: The average two-year fix against Bank Rate, January to November 2026
subtitle: Start of each month, all LTVs. Bank Rate rose to 4% on 5 November.
source: Moneyfacts UK Mortgage Trends Treasury Report; Bank of England.
note: Moneyfacts start-of-month figures, read on Moneyfacts releases and trade press reproducing them (January to November 2026). Bank Rate from the Monetary Policy Summaries: 3.75% from 18 December 2025 to 4 November 2026.
caption: Average two-year fixed mortgage rate, %. Source: Moneyfacts.
summary: The average two-year fixed mortgage rate rises from 4.83% in January 2026 to 5.97% in November, most of it in March, while Bank Rate stays at 3.75%.
